description_en: Calls DeleteMPULayout to delete an MPU (Mixed Push Unit) layout for stream relay to CDN
description_zh: 调用DeleteMPULayout删除旁路直播布局
name: DeleteMPULayout

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Only a single ID can be passed. You can create and query the ID in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。仅支持传单个ID，您可以在控制台创建和查询
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The layout ID. Only a single ID can be passed. To obtain the layout ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/162192.html
parameters.help_zh: 布局ID。仅支持传单个ID，获取布局ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/162192.html
parameters.name: layout_id
